title: rosa obtusifolia subsp. tomentella
intro: Rosa obtusifolia subsp. tomentella, commonly known as the hairy rose or Chinese rose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Rosa obtusifolia subsp. tomentella include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic effects, making it useful in treating conditions such as hypertension, arthritis, and urinary disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
